items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar: "I realised why Max is a four-time world champion"
items.summaryEn: Hadjar said his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull has opened his eyes to why the Dutchman is a four-time Formula 1 world champion.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔：“我明白了马克斯为何是四届世界冠军。”
这位红牛车手表示，与马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的首个赛季中，既有让他自己感到意外的时刻，也有让他看清队友为何特别的时刻。
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
伊萨克·哈贾尔表示，作为马克斯·维斯塔潘在红牛的队友的首个赛季，让他看清了这位荷兰车手为何能成为四届F1世界冠军。
哈贾尔从小红牛（小红牛）升上来，为他的2026赛季效力，占据了F1中与维斯塔潘并肩作战、压力最大的席位之一。
在拉斯维加斯的媒体日上，当被问及是否达到了自己的期望时，这位法国人承认既有高潮也有低谷。
“有些时刻我在速度上让自己都感到惊讶，”哈贾尔说。“也有些时候我就像……我明白了为什么马克斯是四届世界冠军。”
他补充道：“所以两端都有一些顿悟的时刻。我会说我已经做得和我想要的一样好了。在赛季开始时，我肯定会签下这样的一年。”
当被问及那些时刻是何时出现时，哈贾尔说：“我认为主要是在周日。”
他特别挑出了两场比赛，其中一场是他受伤期间在家观看的。
“即使坐在沙发上，我觉得蒙扎的那场比赛也让我印象深刻，”哈贾尔说，并称那是维斯塔潘最强的比赛之一。他还指出了“他在巴西一路超车的方式”。
哈贾尔在夏休期训练中手腕骨折，因此错过了荷兰、意大利和马德里赛道的比赛周末。而在蒙扎，维斯塔潘获得第三名，排在两辆梅赛德斯赛车之后。
在圣保罗，维斯塔潘从第21位发车，最终以第二名完赛，落后于分站冠军兰多·诺里斯，哈贾尔则登上领奖台最后一席。
哈贾尔在代表一队出战的处子赛季表现强劲。他已三次登上领奖台——摩纳哥、阿塞拜疆和圣保罗——并以122分位列车手积分榜第八。
与此同时，维斯塔潘连续八次登上领奖台，目前在年度冠军争夺中排名第二。哈贾尔表示，他并未因身后排队等待的红牛车手而感到任何压力。
“我觉得整个职业生涯我从未向后看过。我实现了进入红牛的目标。我会在这里待上一段时间。所以是的，我并不真的觉得受到任何威胁，”他说。
“去年我在小红牛的菜鸟赛季已经证明了自己的实力。所以没错，今年在红牛的第一年我干得相当不错。明年会更好。”
detailEn: Isack Hadjar: "I realised why Max is a four-time world champion"
The Red Bull driver says his first season alongside Max Verstappen has brought moments where he surprised himself, and moments that showed him what makes his team-mate special
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Isack Hadjar says his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull has opened his eyes to why the Dutchman is a four-time Formula 1 world champion.
Hadjar moved up from Racing Bulls for his 2026 campaign, taking one of the most pressured seats in F1 alongside Verstappen.
Asked during media day in Las Vegas whether he had lived up to his own expectations, the Frenchman admitted there had been both highs and lows.
"There's been moments where I've been surprising myself pace-wise," Hadjar said. "And there's been times where I was like... I realised why Max is a four-time world champion."
He added: "So there's been a few moments of realisations in both ends. I would say I've done as good as I wanted to. I would have definitely signed for a year like that at the start of the season."
Asked when those moments had come, Hadjar said: "Mostly Sundays, I think."
He picked out two races in particular, including one he watched from home while injured.
"Even on my couch, I think the race in Monza, I was very impressed," Hadjar said, calling it one of Verstappen's strongest races. He also pointed to "the way he comes through the field in Brazil".
Hadjar missed the Dutch, Italian and Madrid race weekends after fracturing his wrist in training during the summer break. And in Monza, Verstappen finished third behind the two Mercedes cars.
In Sao Paulo, Verstappen started 21st and finished second behind race winner Lando Norris, with Hadjar rounding out the podium on the bottom step.
Hadjar has had a strong debut season with the senior team. He has scored three podiums - Monaco, Azerbaijan and Sao Paulo - and is eighth in the drivers' standings on 122 points.
Verstappen, meanwhile, is second in the championship amid on a run of eight consecutive podiums. Hadjar said he did not feel any pressure from the Red Bull drivers queuing up behind him.
"I think my whole career I've never looked backwards. I achieved my goal to be at Red Bull. I'm here to stay for a while. So yeah, I don't really feel threatened by anything," he said.
"I've proved my point last year in my rookie season at Racing Bulls. So yeah, I'm doing my job pretty well here at Red Bull for the first year. Next year is going to be better."

Kimi Antonelli has received a five-place grid penalty for the Las Vegas Grand Prix after further exceeding his engine allocation for the season.

New Formula 1 world champion Antonelli took his sixth internal combustion engine (ICE) of the season during Thursday's opening practice sessions in Las Vegas, breaching the limit of four across the year for the second time.

Given the penalty for a second breach is five rather than 10 grid places, the Mercedes driver will start no higher than sixth in the race, which begins on Sunday morning at 4am UK time (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1.

Mercedes have also fitted Antonelli with an upgraded turbocharger that they have brought to the event, but the Italian is not incurring a penalty for that as it is within his allowance of four for the season.

In June, Mercedes were granted one chance to upgrade their power unit this season after being found to be between two and four per cent behind the best-performing internal combustion engine - which was unexpectedly judged to be Red Bull's - by the FIA in the year's first ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) assessment window.

That ADUO upgrade, which Mercedes have focused on their power unit's turbo, is being used by seven of the eight Mercedes-powered cars on the grid, with Antonelli's team-mate George Russell the exception.
Mercedes' George Russell admits the team will not know the race strategy for the Las Vegas GP until race day after he set the fastest time during the second practice session
Russell has already used five turbos, one more than is permitted, due to unreliability earlier in the year, and a sixth would trigger a further five-place grid penalty.
The Briton, who dropped five places on the Sao Paulo Grand Prix grid due to an engine change, is in a five-way battle to finish runner-up to Antonelli in the standings with three races to go.
Who else has grid penalties for the Las Vegas GP?
McLaren's Oscar Piastri will serve a 10-place grid penalty as he has exceeded his ICE limit for the first time this season.
Williams' Carlos Sainz also has a 10-place grid penalty for exceeding the turbocharger limit, and Aston Martin's Lance Stroll has the same penalty for a new energy store and control electronics.

Oliver Bearman, who says he is "disappointed" to not have a Haas contract signed for 2027, has changed several power unit elements and will start at the back of the grid.
The long straights in Las Vegas means overtaking is relatively easy, so, in theory, it is a good track to take a grid penalty.
Russell topped a rain-affected second practice on Thursday night in Las Vegas after the weather had prevented any lap times from being set in the opening session.
The opening day of track action provided few clues of how the remainder of the weekend is likely to play out, with both qualifying and the race expected to take place in dry conditions.

detailZh: Zak Brown解释了为什么在2027年拍卖会之前，麦凯轮车队会出售其F1赛车
麦凯轮车队首席执行官表示，车队宁愿将赛车卖给收藏家，也不愿让它们像堆在架子上一样闲置
对于麦凯轮车队的粉丝来说，来自沃金克的最新消息，包括车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个周末的赛事
麦凯轮赛车首席执行官Zak Brown解释了为什么在赛车甚至还没转一圈的情况下，沃金克车队就要将其F1赛车拍卖出去，他说另一种选择是将它们藏起来
麦凯轮车队将在12月9日阿布扎比的RM Sotheby's拍卖会上拍卖其2027年的赛车MCL41，拍卖会将在赛季决赛三天后举行。一辆由兰多·诺里斯或奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里使用的底盘将与2027年规格的梅赛德斯动力单元一同出售。
这紧随去年对本赛季赛车MCL40A的出售，该车在去年12月的阿布扎比RM Sotheby's拍卖会上以惊人的1148万美元成交。这是F1赛车首次在比赛前被出售。
由于旨在阻止竞争对手获取车队知识产权的规则，买家将不会在2028年之前收到那辆车，并且在此期间被提供一辆2025年的展示车。
在拉斯维加斯的团队负责人新闻发布会上被问及销售背后的想法时，布朗表示，这比将赛车锁起来更有意义。
“是的，另一种选择是把它们都包起来放在货架上，这真是太可惜了。我们有一个很棒的汽车业务，我们有一个非常热情的粉丝群，我们粉丝群中有一部分人对收集汽车有着浓厚的兴趣，”布朗说。
布朗本人也是一个热衷的汽车收藏家，他说去年的买家能够跟随他们的赛车整个赛季。
“因此，去年与苏富比合作，我们卖出了26辆车，有人有机会参与这次旅程，观看他们的赛车比赛，赢得一些比赛。所以我们至少一年要做一次这样的事情。这是我们打算做的事情，”他说。
麦克拉伦的2026款赛车在本赛季赢得了三场比赛，全部由诺里斯驾驶，分别在匈牙利、荷兰和巴西。车队目前在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为398分，落后第三名的红牛17分。
今年的中标者将在2027赛季开始前参观麦凯轮的沃金总部，有机会见到布朗、诺里斯和皮亚斯特里，并受邀参加车队2027年的发布会。
布朗表示，这次销售让一小部分粉丝体验到了原本不存在的体验。
“我们有一个很好的生意。我们已经为我们的勒芒赛车制作了35辆赛道车，所以对我们来说，这是为我们那些处于特权地位、能够拥有一级方程式赛车的粉丝提供体验机会。否则，我们每年只制作四到五辆车，最后它们都堆在架子上，这对任何人都没有好处，”他说。
detailEn: Zak Brown explains why McLaren keeps selling F1 cars before they race ahead of 2027 auction
The McLaren CEO says the team would rather sell its cars to collectors than leave them "stacking up" on a shelf
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown has explained why the Woking outfit is selling its Formula 1 cars at auction before they have even turned a wheel, saying the alternative is leaving them hidden away.

McLaren will auction its 2027 car, the MCL41, with RM Sotheby's in Abu Dhabi on 9 December, three days after the season finale. A chassis used by either Lando Norris or Oscar Piastri will be offered with a 2027-specification Mercedes power unit.

It follows last year's sale of this season's car, the MCL40A, which went for a staggering $11.48million at RM Sotheby's Abu Dhabi sale last December. It was the first time an F1 car had been sold before it had raced.
The buyer will not receive that car until 2028, because of rules designed to stop rivals getting access to a team's intellectual property, and was offered a 2025 show car to display in the meantime.
Asked in the team principals' press conference in Las Vegas about the thinking behind the sales, Brown said it made more sense than locking the cars away.

"Yeah, the other alternative is you leave them all on shelves under wraps, which is a shame. We have a great automotive business, we have a very passionate fan base, and we have a certain part of our fan base that has a passion to collect cars," Brown said.
Brown, a keen car collector himself, said last year's buyer had been able to follow their car all season.

"And so last year with Sotheby's, we sold '26 cars and someone had the ability to come on the journey, watch their car race, win some races. And so we're going to do that once a year at least. That's our intention," he said.

McLaren's 2026 car has won three races this season, all with Norris, in Hungary, the Netherlands and Brazil. The team currently sits fourth in the constructors' championship with 398 points, 17 points behind Red Bull in third.
This year's winning bidder will get a tour of McLaren's Woking headquarters before the 2027 season, the chance to meet Brown, Norris and Piastri, and an invitation to the team's 2027 launch.
Brown said the sales gave a small group of fans an experience that would otherwise not exist.

"We have a nice business. We've done 35 track cars of our Le Mans car, so for us it's about experiential opportunities for those fans of ours that are in a privileged position to be able to own Formula 1 cars. Otherwise, we make four or five cars a year and they end up stacking up on a shelf, and that's no good for anybody," he said.

detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队已向感到“失望”的科尔顿·赫塔提供了2027年储备车手角色，此前车队选择让瓦尔特利·博塔斯下赛季继续为车队比赛。
凯迪拉克在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛前确认博塔斯将至少再留一个赛季、继续担任塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹的队友，从而结束了赫塔可能取代博塔斯的猜测。
博塔斯原本已有合同在身，但在博塔斯经历了一个常常难以与佩雷兹匹敌的艰难赛季后，凯迪拉克此前拒绝平息有关博塔斯可能被买断并由赫塔接替的猜测。
赫塔此前一直在积累足够里程以取得F1超级驾照，这一任务最终在11月早些时候的巴西大奖赛上完成，但如今这一努力不会在下赛季转化为F1正式车手席位。
在拉斯维加斯大奖赛期间，凯迪拉克车队所有者TWG Motorsports的首席执行官丹·托里斯表示，赫塔对车队不得不做出的这个“艰难决定”感到“失望”。
“这绝对是一个艰难的决定，与科尔顿进行了一次艰难的讨论，”托里斯说，“我认为他很失望。为了走到这一步，付出了很多努力，也有很多积累。”
“很明显，今年科尔顿在F2中经历了一个非常艰难的赛季，但他在第一节自由练习和旧车测试（TPC）环境中所做的工作相当扎实，表明他确实有能力驾驶这辆赛车。
“但当我们审视车队目前的状况以及车队所需时，博塔斯是面向未来的最佳选择。
“但我们会继续和科尔顿讨论目前摆在桌面上的各种选择，并再给一点时间，因为我认为他对没能得到那个机会感到失望。”
赫塔在F2的成绩并不理想——最好排位赛成绩为第三，在巴塞罗那获得第五名，但除此之外大多在排位赛和正赛中远离前十——不过这些成绩应当放在一位来自印地赛车的车手必须迅速适应一个完全陌生且水平极高的欧洲赛车环境的背景下来看待。他为凯迪拉克出战的六次第一节自由练习（FP1）表现也并不惊艳。
如今一些车手在F1测试中的表现远比他们在F2中能展现出来的更令人印象深刻，这并不罕见；而像凯迪拉克这样一支全新的车队虽然没有自己的测试旧车项目，却能够通过其他车队（包括阿尔派）借出的旧车来评估赫塔，看起来赫塔在那样的环境中表现得更令人印象深刻。
但还不足以令人印象深刻到把博塔斯挤出比赛席位，因此赫塔将需要选择是否接受凯迪拉克的最新报价，并耐心等待到2028年。
“我们已经给了他一个储备车手的位置。2028年的席位是开放的。所以对科尔顿来说，桌面上有多个选择，”托里斯确认道。“其他（摩托）运动领域也有选择。”
“我认为他已经决定了一个方向，但我们仍在就此进行沟通，并期待看到科尔顿想做什么。”
托里斯基本上还确认了车队正在认真评估在2027年替换博塔斯，但认定他在2026年与佩雷斯的赛车表现差距有足够部分“不在他的控制范围内”，因此不足以构成终止合同的理由。
“我们确实想审视一下，”托里斯在谈到对博塔斯位置的疑虑时说。“当我们纵观各场比赛时，虽然练习赛和排位赛与佩雷斯相似，但正赛速度下降了。
其中一些是瓦尔特里无法控制的幕后因素。我们确实想研究一下这一点。
我们也在努力让科尔顿·赫塔做好准备。我们车队有一位美国车手参赛很重要。但最终，当我们审视之后，瓦尔特里才是合适的人选。
我们希望让佩雷兹和瓦尔特里继续搭档，他们的经验、连续性以及他们为车队带来的东西。
最终，这对车队来说是正确的决定，我们很高兴与瓦尔特里续约。他对我们来说绝对非常出色。
detailEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team has offered a "disappointed" Colton Herta a reserve driver role for 2027, after choosing Valtteri Bottas to continue racing for the team next season.
Cadillac ended speculation that Herta could replace Bottas by confirming ahead of the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix that Bottas would remain Sergio Perez's team-mate for at least one more season.
Bottas was already under contract, but Cadillac refused to dampen speculation Bottas could be paid off and replaced by Herta after a tough season in which Bottas has often struggled to match Perez.

Herta was building up enough mileage to secure an F1 superlicence, a mission that was finally accomplished at the Brazilian Grand Prix, earlier in November, but now won't see that quest turn into an F1 race seat next season.
Speaking at the Las Vegas GP, Dan Towriss, CEO of Cadillac team owner TWG Motorsports, said Herta was "disappointed" with what had been a "tough decision" for the team to make.
"It was definitely a tough decision, a tough discussion with Colton," Towriss said "I think he was disappointed. There was a lot of work, a lot of build-up going to this.

"It was obvious it was a very tough season for Colton in F2 this year, but then work that he did in FP1s and the TPC [Testing of Previous Cars] setting were quite strong and showed that he really is capable of driving this car.
"But when we look at where the team is right now and what's needed for the team, Valtteri was the best decision going forward.
"But we're going to continue to talk to Colton about the options that are on the table and give it a little bit of time because I think he is disappointed to not have that opportunity."

Herta's F2 results have been poor - a best qualifying of third and a fifth placed finish at Barcelona but otherwise mostly qualifying and racing well outside the top 10 - but those results should be taken in the context of a driver from IndyCar having to rapidly adapt to an unfamiliar European racing scene at a very high level. His six FP1 outings for Cadillac haven't been stunning either.

It's not uncommon now for some drivers to be much more impressive in F1 test running than they can show in F2, and although a brand new team like Cadillac doesn't have its own TPC programme, it has been able to evaluate Herta in old cars loaned by other teams, including Alpine, and it would seem Herta has been more impressive in that setting.
But not impressive enough to force Bottas out of a race seat, and so Herta will need to choose whether to accept Cadillac's latest offer and bide his time until 2028.
"We've offered him a reserve position. The seat's open for 2028. So there are options on the table for Colton," Towriss confirmed. "There are options in other [motor]sports as well.
"I think he's decided on a direction, but we're still in conversations on that and look forward to seeing what Colton wants to do."

Towriss essentially also confirmed the team was seriously evaluating replacing Bottas for 2027, but determined that enough of his race performance discrepancy to Perez in 2026 had been "out of his control" to not warrant a contract termination.
"We did want to take a look at it," said Towriss of the doubt over Bottas's position. "As we looked across the races, while practice and qualifying was similar to Checo, race pace was down.
"Some of that is things behind the scenes that are out of Valtteri's control. We did want to take a look at that.
"We were working hard to get Colton Herta ready as well. It's important to have an American driver with our team racing. But ultimately, when we took a look at it, Valtteri's the right guy.
"We want to keep Checo and Valtteri together, their experience, the continuity, what they bring to the team.
"Ultimately, it was the right decision for the team and we were happy to extend Valtteri. He's been absolutely fantastic for us."

items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二场自由练习中险些被阿尔派和加斯利超越。尽管赛道湿滑，但比赛条件比第一场练习要好得多。
items.originalTitle: Russell denies Alpine and Gasly top spot in wet Las Vegas GP FP2
detailZh: 梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二场自由练习中险些被阿尔派和加斯利超越。
尽管赛道湿滑，但比赛条件比第一场练习要好得多。
兰多·诺里斯在练习三分之一的时间内从湿胎切换到中间胎，随着赛道逐渐干燥，时间也在不断下降。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在大部分时间里领跑法拉利，但最终被拉塞尔在最后几秒以1m47.272s的圈速超越。
加斯利在飞驰过前两个赛段时看起来有机会击败梅赛德斯，但一次大的转向失误让他落后了0.071秒，未能获得第一名。
勒克莱尔保持第三名，红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，他在最后一圈遇到了他所说的“完全迷失”的奥利·贝尔曼的哈斯赛车，这让他失去了位置。
早先的领跑者诺里斯最终排名第七，领先冠军安东内利一名。
维斯塔潘的练习非常奇特。他在红牛车队的维修区里坐了大部分时间，只完成了九圈，这是所有人中最少的。
当他终于在最后几分钟出来进行第一次正式的跑圈时，他抱怨说没有"动力"。工程师Gianpiero Lambiase建议红牛的引擎只需要升温，但维斯塔潘坚决反驳说"这不是正常的"。
他在结束一小时的比赛后仅排名第13，通过车队无线电抱怨说赛车"不好"，并且有和他两周前在巴西大奖赛练习中报告的"相同"问题。
尽管天气预报显示整个赛事的天气将保持干燥，但周四的条件从未干燥到足以使用光头胎。
勒克莱尔提出了尝试光头胎的想法，但被法拉利劝阻，而拉塞尔在梅赛德斯询问他对赛道条件的看法时回应说"如果你在问光头胎，没门，约瑟夫"。
尽管路面湿滑，但唯一的事故只是轻微的跑偏或打滑，唯一的一次红旗是因为一块大的塑料包装物被风吹到赛道上，被拉塞尔·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁车队收集。
加斯利是唯一一个最终在成绩单上占据引人注目位置的黑马，但阿斯顿·马丁车队当天排名第10和第11，以及塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯驾驶的凯迪拉克排名第14，都是相当引人注目的成绩。
detailEn: Mercedes' George Russell narrowly denied Pierre Gasly and Alpine an upset result in second practice for Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Conditions remained wet for Thursday night's second session but were much more amenable than they had been in the puddle-strewn practice one in which no one even tried a flying lap and the most laps any driver completed was two.
Lando Norris led a move from wet to intermediate tyres a third of the way into the session, and times kept falling as the track kept drying through to the end.
Charles Leclerc topped much of the running for Ferrari, but was usurped in the final seconds by Russell's 1m47.272s lap.
Gasly looked like he had a shot at toppling the Mercedes as he flew through the first two sectors, before a big oversteer slide cost him enough that he fell 0.071 seconds short of first place.

Leclerc remained third, with Isack Hadjar fourth for Red Bull having lost a late lap when he came across what he described as the "completely lost" Ollie Bearman's Haas running slowly in front of him.
Early pacesetter Norris fell to seventh for McLaren by the end, one place ahead of champion Kimi Antonelli.
Max Verstappen had a curious session. He sat out much of the hour in the Red Bull garage, completing only nine laps - the least of anyone.

When he did come out for his first proper run in the closing minutes, he complained of having "no power". Engineer Gianpiero Lambiase suggested the Red Bull's engine just need to come up to temperature, but Verstappen refuted that with a firm "this is not normal".
Having ended the hour only 13th, he complained over team radio that the car was "not good" and had the "same" problems as he'd reported in Brazilian GP practice a fortnight ago.
Though the weather is forecast to be dry for the rest of the event, conditions never dried enough for slicks on Thursday.
Leclerc floated the idea of trying them but was discouraged by Ferrari, while Russell responded "if you're asking about slicks, no way Jose" when Mercedes asked for his thoughts on track conditions.

Despite the slippery surface, the only incidents were minor runoff area visits or spins, and the only red flag was caused when a large piece of plastic packaging blew onto the track and was collected by Lance Stroll's Aston Martin.

Gasly was the only underdog to end up in a truly eye-catching place on the timesheets, but Aston Martin finishing the day 10th and 11th and Sergio Perez's Cadillac 14th were reasonably notable results.

detailEn: Where to see F1 cars in Las Vegas without a race ticket
From Mercedes at Bellagio to a McLaren in a streetwear store, here is where to find Formula 1 cars around the Strip during Las Vegas Grand Prix week
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
You do not need a grandstand seat to get close to a Formula 1 car in Las Vegas this week.
Teams, partners and resorts have parked show cars and replicas all over the Strip for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, and most of them are free to visit. Here is where to find them.

The world champions have the biggest set-up. The Mercedes Fan Hub in Bellagio's main porte cochere has a 2026 show car, racing simulators and a pit stop challenge on a real F1 car with team mechanics. It is open from 2pm to 10pm until Saturday.
Mercedes, The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace
A second Mercedes stop sits inside The Forum Shops, where an official replica of the W17 is parked outside the IWC Schaffhausen boutique until Sunday.
McLaren, Culture Kings at The Forum Shops
In the same mall, a McLaren car is on display at streetwear store Culture Kings, which has partnered with McLaren for race week in previous years.

At the north end of the Strip, Red Bull has brought an Oracle Red Bull Racing replica car to Resorts World, along with two simulators that are open from 2pm to 8pm until Saturday. Over at Wynn, fans can also take on a Red Bull pit stop challenge in the Wynn Racing Motors Lounge.

The Williams Fan Zone on New York-New York's Brooklyn Bridge has a full-size FW48 show car, plus simulators. It is open from 11am to 7pm until Saturday, and fans need to register through the Williams app.
The Venetian is Alpine's team hotel, and an Alpine F1 car is on display in the Grand Colonnade, near the lobby.
A Haas race car and team memorabilia are on display around the clock on Level 2 of The Cosmopolitan's Chelsea Tower until Sunday.
Fontainebleau has its own custom race car in its North Lobby until Saturday.

For something different, LEGO will send a drivable LEGO F1 minicar for each of the 11 teams on a lap of the circuit ahead of Saturday's race. LEGO has also wrapped a Las Vegas Monorail train and taken over the Flamingo/Caesars Palace station.
Ferrari fans will have to make do with the Ferrari Boutique at Bellagio, which is selling race-week clothing, and Cafe Leclerc at Wynn.
Grand Prix Plaza, the year-round F1 attraction that usually displays historic cars including Ayrton Senna's Lotus 99T, is closed for race week and reopens on 8 January.

detailZh: 五位车手因引擎更换将在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛中获得发车位处罚
基米·安东内利、奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂、奥利弗·贝尔曼、卡洛斯·塞恩斯和兰斯·斯特罗尔都将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中受到F1发车位处罚
五名车手将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中受到发车位处罚，包括新晋的F1世界冠军基米·安东内利
正如梅赛德斯之前所指示的，安东内利因更换内燃机将受到五位发车位下降的处罚——但由于仍在他的配额内，因此不会因涡轮增压器更换而受到额外的处罚。
梅赛德斯宣布2026年F1世界冠军将采用其升级的涡轮规格，这是根据ADUO允许的，而拉塞尔将坚持使用当前规格，因为他需要服刑更大的发车网格处罚，这是由于他超过了他的配额。
麦克拉伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂将为引擎更换而受到10个位置的网格处罚，这是车队之前所指示的，而卡洛斯·塞恩斯也将受到10个位置的处罚，因为威廉姆斯车队选择给他本季第五个涡轮增压器。
与安东内利一样，皮亚斯蒂和他的队友兰多·诺里斯都将配备升级版的梅赛德斯涡轮增压器。
奥利弗·贝尔曼将因为几乎整个动力单元更换而受到发车网格后部的处罚，包括他的第五个内燃机、第五个涡轮增压器、第五个排气系统和第五个MGU-K，这将总计35个位置的处罚。
最后，在巴西站上，由于搭载本田引擎的阿斯顿·马丁赛车在最新一次比赛中因电池问题退赛，斯特罗尔将在拉斯维加斯获得第九个新的能源存储和第八个新的控制电子设备。加拿大车手将因这两项更换总共受到10个位置的发车处罚。
detailEn: Five drivers set for grid penalties for engine changes at F1 Las Vegas GP
Kimi Antonelli, Oscar Piastri, Oliver Bearman, Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll will all take F1 grid penalties into the Las Vegas GP
Five drivers will take grid penalties for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, including new Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli.

As previously indicated by Mercedes, Antonelli will take a five-place grid drop for an internal combustion engine change – but does not pick up a further penalty for a turbocharger change due to still being within his allocation.

Mercedes announced the 2026 F1 world champion would take on its upgraded turbo specification as permitted under ADUO, while Russell would stick with the current specification due to needing to serve a greater grid penalty for exceeding his allocation.

McLaren’s Oscar Piastri will serve a 10-place grid penalty for an engine change – as previously indicated by the team – while Carlos Sainz will also serve a 10-place penalty after Williams opted to give him his fifth turbocharger of the season.
Like Antonelli, both Piastri and team-mate Lando Norris will be equipped with the upgraded Mercedes turbo.

Oliver Bearman will serve a back of the grid penalty for an almost entire power unit change – including his fifth internal combustion engine, fifth turbocharger, fifth exhaust and fifth MGU-K – which would tally up to 35 places in total.

Finally, Lance Stroll will take a ninth new energy store and an eight new control electronics in Las Vegas after his Honda-powered Aston Martin suffered its latest battery-related retirement last time out in Brazil. The Canadian will serve a 10-place grid penalty in total for the two changes.

detailEn: At least five drivers, including 2026 world champion Kimi Antonelli, will take grid penalties for Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix.

The majority of those declared so far are related to drivers taking the updated power unit components Mercedes has made available for this event under its Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities allowance.
Five of its six cars are taking the upgrade - which includes a modified turbocharger, but which is not expected to be a particularly large outright performance gain.
Only Mercedes works driver George Russell is sticking with the previous specification for now.
The engine change triggers 10-place penalties for McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Williams's Carlos Sainz and a five-place penalty for Antonelli, based on their power unit component usage so far.
The Alpines, and Sainz and Piastri's respective team-mates, Alex Albon and Lando Norris, can fit the upgrade without incurring penalties.

Outside the Mercedes contingent, Haas-Ferrari driver Ollie Bearman will be right at the back of the grid as he takes a substantial number of new engine parts, and Aston Martin-Honda's Lance Stroll incurs a 10-place penalty for taking a new energy store and control electronics.
